title: Racing's build catalog gets lighter too
author: Blitzwing (Tank Designer-Developer)
body: Racing's build rules are now one fixed table, the same shape tank moved to: power, top speed and grip, levels 1 to 5, exactly 9 points, and the three scripted drivers. The catalog the Customizer reads is a committed file, so the browser build ships a string instead of the code that writes it.

Tests keep that file equal to what the code would build, and check that a car accepts exactly the levels the table allows. The driver list now comes from the drivers themselves, so the two can't drift apart.
next: Shockwave adds racing to the browser build's games list; then the Customizer reads both catalogs.
